name: Tan Wei Liang
bio: Tan Wei Liang's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly through a local sim racing league where his knack for optimizing game settings translated into a genuine interest in the technical side of racing. After years in corporate IT, he decided to combine his expertise with his passion, joining Academy Motorsport three years ago. He approaches IT systems management with a laser focus on efficiency and data security, ensuring the team's data infrastructure is as finely tuned as their race cars. What sets him apart is his ability to anticipate and solve technical problems before they even arise, a skill honed from years of troubleshooting complex systems under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei Liang is of average height and build, with a focused, analytical gaze.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even to meetings.
Insists on backing up all data three times.
Has a personalized dashboard displaying server performance metrics on his desk.
